{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Peculiar Inspiration''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was in existence during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
{{RPG}}
After rescuing the [[Tarasin]] [[Force Adept]]s [[Krizta]] and [[Trik]], the [[Heroes of Cularin]] were loaned use of the ''Peculiar Inspiration'' to transport the Tarasin pair to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. However, a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] sabotaged the ship, causing it to crash on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Holador]].
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[For Every Action: Strike III|Strike III]]'', the player characters, who [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-play]] as the [[Heroes of Cularin]], are only loaned the use of the ''Peculiar Inspiration'' if they lack a suitable [[Transport/Legends|transport]] of their own. If the players are traveling in a ship of their own, then it is that ship, not the ''Inspiration'', that they travel in, and which crashes on Holador.
